xhs-insight-guaikei 1.0.0

- Initial release of the 小红书数据洞察技能 for structured, script-based search and analysis.
- Supports searching, retrieving details, pulling comments, and listing posts for 小红书 (RED/XHS) public content.
- Provides clear usage boundaries for when to trigger the skill, required parameters, and handling of different link formats.
- Includes detailed error handling, output expectations, and common use-case workflows for research, content creation, and business analysis.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN environment variable for all operations.
